integrity: The proof first identifies two necessary local twin obstructions, isolates the unique dead configuration at the local thresholds, proves all remaining configurations force by an explicit sequence, and then enumerates the resulting sets. A separate exhaustive checker reconstructs the graph and applies the color-change rule directly.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to two cliques of orders at least three joined by exactly one bridge edge.
No general bridge-splitting theorem is claimed.
Finite exhaustive verification over 3 <= a,b <= 7 is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently phrased or non-indexed exact formula.
